name: Warble
author: hundekraft
description: A short delay whose time wobbles in two uneven rhythms, so the movement never repeats exactly. Half mix gives chorus; full mix gives vibrato. A slow rate and small depth give tape-like pitch movement. The cassette artwork comes from Maiko's #250 with permission; its hubs turn and the loose tape moves with the controls.
credits: Reconstructs Maiko Pruett's #250 algorithm and artwork, used with permission
